join_order.notes: ~1% of 234997 cn rows pass; dense bitset over id space [1..234997] enables O(1) cn.id membership test.

join_order.build: candidate movie_id set from mk probe

title.id is dense identity; read title.title via off/dat for survivors only and compute MIN.

data_structures.cn_pass: bitset(234998) indexed by cn.id (1..234997); built by single scan of country_code.bin == target_code
data_structures.candidate_movie_ids: std::vector<int32_t> collected from mk CSR rowids' movie_id; deduplicate via flat boolean array sized title.rows (2528313) or sort+unique
data_structures.movie_seen: flat std::vector<uint8_t>(2528313) for dedup of candidate movie ids and to mark survivors

parallelism.notes: Driver mk-by-keyword list is small (few thousand rows); per-movie mc lookups via offsets_only are cheap. Synchronization overhead would dominate. Optionally parallelize cn_pass build with morsel scan but it is dominated by I/O.

indexes.purpose: csr_lookup: skip directly to mk rows for target_k_id
offsets_only: skip to mc rows per candidate movie_id
